title: Email: Cloudflare + SendGrid by default, settings in the super admin console, the R131 gaps closed
goal: Platform system mail goes through Cloudflare with SendGrid as the automatic fallback by default; the super admin changes the email routing from the console without a deploy; every send path uses the EmailProvider interface; platform mail has a delivery log the console shows.
why: Owner, 2026-10-21: "fix the gaps and keep cloudflare and sendgrid as default instead of keeping sendgrid only as default, later in super admin panel I can update the settings."
steps: Default: platform system mail -> Cloudflare (send_email binding) with automatic SendGrid fallback. gen-wrangler default EMAIL_SYSTEM_PROVIDER becomes "cloudflare"; when the binding is missing or Cloudflare refuses, the mail goes through SendGrid and the reason is recorded. Agency mail stays SendGrid (Cloudflare sending is transactional-only).

Runtime settings (master platform_settings, R304 table): system mail provider (cloudflare | sendgrid), fallback on/off, and the inbound reply domain switch; resolution order = console setting, then env default; cached briefly (<= 60 s) and invalidated on write; every change audited with actor and reason.

Super admin console: an Email page showing the current routing per mail kind (system / agency transactional / agency marketing and why marketing cannot use Cloudflare), the provider status (binding present, SendGrid key present, inbound domain), the switches above, a "send test email" action (local stacks: outbox), and the delivery log.

Gap 1, delivery log for platform mail: master table platform_email_log (id, kind/template, to (hashed or masked), provider, fallback_from, message_id, status sent|failed|fallback, error, created_at) written by sendMail for platform_system mail; SendGrid events update rows by message id (reuse R128 delivery-events); Cloudflare has no event webhook, so its rows show "accepted by provider" plus a link note to the Cloudflare dashboard; retention 90 days via the platform cron; add to the privacy registry if it holds addresses.

Gap 2: campaign-queue inline SendGrid fetch and the email-queue template-send path go through EmailProvider (sendMail with kind agency_marketing / agency_transactional), keeping message-id capture, unsubscribe headers and reply-to exactly as today (existing campaign and opt-out tests must pass unchanged).

Docs: GO-LIVE 9.1a and KEYS-AND-ACCOUNTS updated for the new default (Cloudflare sending onboarding needed for it to take effect; until then the fallback sends through SendGrid) and the console switch; rollback = set the console switch to SendGrid.
tests: default routes system mail to Cloudflare and falls back to SendGrid without a binding
console setting overrides env and is audited
marketing never on Cloudflare whatever the setting
campaign and template sends go through sendMail with message ids and headers unchanged
platform_email_log rows for sent, failed and fallback; SendGrid events update them; retention
acceptance: Owner can switch system mail between Cloudflare and SendGrid in the console and see the delivery log
gate: e2e communication-inbox + campaigns + marketing-opt-out + first-login on a local stack
goLiveVerify: Cloudflare sending onboarding for the platform domain so the default takes effect
notes: Master migration 0027 is taken by this batch; R130 moves to 0028.
